title: Cozy Nashville Bungalow
description:
Nashville is a happening place but it's nice to have a relaxing place to get away from the hustle and bustle.  That is exactly what you will experience in our cozy bungalow while still being  a short walk, drive, scooter ride, or ride share from all the the city has to offer.  Use our home as a casual rest and a hub to explore Nashville.

The space
We are  a remodeled 3 bed/2 bath house.  The Primary bedroom boasts a king bed with a full on suite bath and walk in closet.  Bedroom 2 & 3 share the 2nd bath with queen beds in each. We have a fully equipped kitchen & offer all linens and towels needed for your stay.  We offer private and on street parking and a fully fenced back yard to make you feel at home in the big city.

Guest access
You’ll have private access to our whole house.
